tech_stack: Vite 8 + TypeScript 7 + Three.js 0.186 (WebGL2) + Web Audio API (synthesised) + vitest 5; Node 24 / npm 11 on Windows 11. Browser-based because no Unreal/Unity project existed in the environment.
implemented_modules: flight/AircraftConfig (Su-57, F-35, hostile UCAV) + AircraftMesh (original low-poly meshes, cockpit interiors, coloured helmets, under-wing missiles, strobes)
flight/FlightController + flight/Autopilot (shared control laws for AI and QA)
world/Heightfield + Terrain + Airfield + Sky + Landing (procedural valley, runway slab/lights/PAPI/approach lights, landmarks, weather cell, fog/snow/clouds)
avionics/HUD (tapes, conformal pitch ladder, flight-path marker, targeting boxes, lead pipper, radar scope, warnings, ILS cue, objectives)
combat/TargetingSystem + Weapons + WeaponSpecs (cannon with lead calc, LR-9 radar missile, IR-7 Fox-2, flares/chaff, damage)
ai/BanditAI + WingmanAI + Maneuvers (FSMs, formations, commands 1-4, RTB/landing/go-around)
missions/MissionSpecs + MissionDirector (Missions 01-03 and Flight School: drones, waves, valley gates, bonus tasks, radar-network detection, blizzard + interference, scoring, hints)
audio/AudioEngine (synth engines per aircraft, gun, missiles, locks, warnings, radio, music, ambience)
story/DialogueSystem + Script (subtitles, priorities, interference garbling, speech synthesis + babble fallback)
characters/Avatar (coloured pilots) + game/HangarScene (cat and girl mask removed by owner request)
game/GameState (explicit transition table), Game, FlightSession, SceneManager, CameraRig, Input
ui/UI + Settings + MapView, persistence/SaveManager (validated localStorage save)
game/Bindings (rebindable keys incl. Ctrl chords + arrow alternates, editor UI), mouse-aim flight, 6 camera angles on key 5, auto-roll after engine start
flight/ModelCache + tools/convert-models.mjs (user STL/3MF aircraft + pilot models)

voice/CommandParser (natural-language → commands, unit-tested) + VoiceController (command line for Wispr Flow dictation, optional browser speech recognition) + Assists (heading/altitude/speed autopilot, taxi, auto take-off, autoland)
